# Every list resource's config schema, at full fidelity.
#
# The list surfaces are the only schemas in this provider that nothing else
# pins. The baseline projection test covers managed resources and says so
# explicitly; a sibling covers data sources; identity and list-resource schemas
# are named there as separate fact families and are not compared. The behaviour
# inventory covers managed resources at every depth and reports list resources
# as uncovered. So before this file existed, a list config schema could lose
# every description it has and the whole suite would stay green.
#
# That mattered the moment these surfaces started being GENERATED. A generator
# reproduces what the specification tells it to reproduce. Structure is easy to
# get right and easy to check; prose is neither, and prose is what a
# practitioner reads in terraform-ls, in the registry docs and in an error. A
# generated schema that is structurally perfect and silently undescribed is the
# exact shape of defect this estate keeps producing: a fact nobody was asking
# about.
#
# The uniformity gate next to this one compares STRUCTURE across all
# twenty-five and deliberately ignores prose, because twenty-five distinct
# block descriptions are correct and pinning them there would fight every
# wording change while catching nothing structural. This file is the other
# half: it pins the prose, per surface, so a rewording is a visible diff rather
# than an invisible loss.
#
# Each line is "<resource>.<path>  <type:disposition>  <flags>  <description>",
# where flags is sensitive, deprecated, or "-" for neither. A schema's or a
# block's own description is recorded as "<resource>[.<block>]  schema|block  -
# <text>".
#
# Regenerate with: UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./unifi/ -run TestListResourceConfigSchemaGolden
#
# That refuses to drop a line. A rewrite that would remove one has to say so
# with UPDATE_GOLDEN_ALLOW_REMOVAL=1 as well.
unifi_ap_group  schema  -  List AP groups in a site.
unifi_ap_group.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`.
unifi_ap_group.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_ap_group.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list AP groups from.
unifi_client  schema  -  List clients in a site, optionally filtered by network, group, connection type, or vendor.
unifi_client.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `site`, `network_id`, `network_name`, `group`, `wired`, `blocked`, `oui`.
unifi_client.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_client.group  string:optional  -  Filter clients by network members group name.
unifi_client.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list clients from.
unifi_client_qos_rate  schema  -  List client QOS rates in a site.
unifi_client_qos_rate.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`.
unifi_client_qos_rate.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_client_qos_rate.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list client QOS rates from.
unifi_device  schema  -  List devices in a site.
unifi_device.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `mac`, `model`, `type`.
unifi_device.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_device.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list devices from.
unifi_dns_record  schema  -  List DNS records in a site.
unifi_dns_record.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `record_type`, `enabled`.
unifi_dns_record.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_dns_record.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list DNS records from.
unifi_dynamic_dns  schema  -  List dynamic DNS configurations in a site.
unifi_dynamic_dns.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `host_name`, `service`.
unifi_dynamic_dns.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_dynamic_dns.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list dynamic DNS configurations from.
unifi_firewall_group  schema  -  List firewall groups in a site.
unifi_firewall_group.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `type`.
unifi_firewall_group.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_firewall_group.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list firewall groups from.
unifi_firewall_policy  schema  -  List firewall policies in a site.
unifi_firewall_policy.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `action`, `enabled`.
unifi_firewall_policy.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_firewall_policy.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list firewall policies from.
unifi_firewall_rule  schema  -  List firewall rules in a site.
unifi_firewall_rule.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `ruleset`, `action`, `enabled`.
unifi_firewall_rule.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_firewall_rule.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list firewall rules from.
unifi_firewall_zone  schema  -  List firewall zones in a site.
unifi_firewall_zone.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`.
unifi_firewall_zone.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_firewall_zone.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list firewall zones from.

unifi_site  schema  -  List sites in the UniFi controller.
unifi_site.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `description`.
unifi_site.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_site_to_site_vpn  schema  -  List site-to-site VPN networks in a site.
unifi_site_to_site_vpn.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`.
unifi_site_to_site_vpn.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_site_to_site_vpn.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list site-to-site VPN networks from.
unifi_static_route  schema  -  List static routes in a site.
unifi_static_route.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `type`. The `type` filter matches the static route type (`interface-route`, `nexthop-route`, `blackhole`).
unifi_static_route.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_static_route.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list static routes from.
unifi_traffic_route  schema  -  List traffic routes in a site.
unifi_traffic_route.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `enabled`, `matching_target`, `network_id`, `description`.
unifi_traffic_route.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_traffic_route.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list traffic routes from.

unifi_wireguard_peer  schema  -  List WireGuard peers of a WireGuard server network.
unifi_wireguard_peer.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`.
unifi_wireguard_peer.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_wireguard_peer.network_id  string:required  -  The ID of the WireGuard server network to list peers from.
unifi_wireguard_peer.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site the WireGuard server belongs to.
unifi_wlan  schema  -  List WLANs in a site.
unifi_wlan.filter.name  string:required  -  The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `enabled`.
unifi_wlan.filter.value  string:required  -  The value to filter by.
unifi_wlan.site  string:optional  -  The name of the site to list WLANs from.
